description:
8 Dun Oir Court is a beautifully presented semi-detached 5/6 bedroom home in Kilternan, extending to approximately 194 sqm over three floors. Generous living spaces, a flexible upper-floor layout and a landscaped west-facing rear garden combine to create an inviting home designed around family life.



Built in 2023 and carrying an excellent A2 energy rating, No.8 offers a bright, inviting interior with a calm neutral palette and thoughtfully arranged spaces for family life. A separate ground-floor living room provides a comfortable retreat, while the kitchen and dining room opens directly to the garden, creating a natural setting for everyday meals and entertaining. The Shaker-style kitchen features quartz worktops and NEFF appliances, complemented by a separate utility room. On the first floor, a generous children`s reception room and home office offers a flexible second living space and could equally serve as a fifth bedroom. The primary bedroom occupies the front of the top floor and benefits from a walk-in wardrobe and en suite.

 Four bedrooms are arranged across the upper two floors, with an additional home office on the top floor. A family bathroom, an additional top-floor shower room and a ground-floor guest WC support the accommodation. The versatile first-floor reception provides the option of a fifth bedroom, allowing the layout to adapt as family needs change.

The west-facing rear garden is a standout feature of No.8. A paved terrace beside the house creates an inviting setting for outdoor dining, with a central lawn and further paving providing space to relax and entertain. Planted beds, boundary fencing and a mature tree line add greenery and a sense of privacy. A garden shed provides outdoor storage, and a side passage connects front and rear. At the front, the paved driveway offers off-street parking alongside established planting and the attractive brick facade. 

Dun Oir Court offers a residential setting in Kilternan, within reach of the shops, cafes and everyday amenities of Stepaside and the wider Dublin 18 area. Carrickmines, Dundrum and Stillorgan provide further shopping, dining and leisure options. The location combines access to the M50 and the Luas at Leopardstown Valley with the outdoor appeal of the Dublin and Wicklow Mountains. The surrounding area offers golf, equestrian and other recreational facilities, making it an appealing base for buyers who value both suburban convenience and access to the countryside.
There is plenty for families to look forward to nearby, with the emerging Kilternan Village development set to bring a new village green and a welcoming centre for local life. Planned amenities include an anchor retail store, convenience shops, a cafe and restaurant, a creche, a medical centre and community facilities. Nature trails, public green spaces, play facilities and outdoor exercise areas promise more opportunities for fresh air, family outings and active afternoons. As the development progresses, these additions are set to make everyday shopping, childcare and meeting friends more convenient, further enhancing Kilternan`s appeal as a place to put down roots.

1.65 m x 2.35 m. An additional shower room accessed from the landing, providing a useful separate facility for the upper-floor rooms.

Outside

Front Garden:
A paved driveway provides off-street parking, complemented by established planting. A side passage connects the front of the property to the rear garden.

Rear Garden:
A landscaped west-facing garden with a central lawn, paved patio areas and planted boundaries, ideal for outdoor dining and relaxing in the afternoon and evening sun. A garden shed provides useful storage, with side access to the front.
